findings.evidenceJa: とすん、と力なく腰を下ろした
findings.governingReading: drops weakly onto the bed with a soft thump
findings.explanation: The sound and physical depletion in Sakura’s collapse are omitted.

findings.highlight: Senpai. He’s so badly injured, and still
findings.evidenceJa: 先輩。あんな怪我をしたのに、まだ
findings.governingReading: Senpai, even after being hurt that badly, you still…
findings.explanation: Her unfinished direct address to Shirou is abruptly shifted into third-person commentary.

findings.highlight: looked as lifeless as a starving man
findings.evidenceJa: たった数時間で絶食したかのようにやつれ
findings.governingReading: had become gaunt in only a few hours, as though he had fasted
findings.explanation: Rapid emaciation is changed into lifelessness and the fasting comparison into a generic starving man.

findings.highlight: she has to fight to remain conscious
findings.evidenceJa: 気をしっかり持っていないと倒れてしまいそう
findings.governingReading: unless she keeps a firm grip on herself, she feels liable to collapse
findings.explanation: Physical collapse is narrowed to loss of consciousness.

findings.highlight: It must be a light cold
findings.governingReading: could it be a mild cold

findings.evidenceJa: 流行り病にはかからない少女
findings.governingReading: a girl who does not contract epidemic illnesses
findings.explanation: A specific resistance to circulating illness becomes generally good health.

findings.highlight: With sluggish movements, she reaches over and turns off the light
findings.evidenceJa: だるい体に鞭を打って電気を消す
findings.governingReading: she drives her listless body to switch off the light
findings.explanation: The force Sakura must exert against her condition is removed.

findings.highlight: She lets herself fall to the bed
findings.evidenceJa: ぼすん、とベッドに倒れ込んだ
findings.governingReading: she collapses onto the bed with a soft heavy “bosun”
findings.explanation: The impact sound and exhausted weight of the fall disappear.

findings.highlight: The girl recalls what she saw
findings.evidenceJa: うつ伏せになったまま
findings.governingReading: still lying face-down, the girl recalls what she saw
findings.explanation: Sakura’s posture, continuous from collapsing onto the bed, is omitted.

findings.highlight: The blackening bruise on his stomach
findings.evidenceJa: 重い鈍器で叩かれ、真っ黒に腫れたお腹の痣
findings.governingReading: the black, swollen abdominal bruise left by a heavy blunt blow
findings.explanation: The wound’s cause, swelling, and location are all reduced.

findings.evidenceJa: 心身共に傷ついていたのに
findings.governingReading: although he was wounded in both mind and body
findings.explanation: The parallel physical and emotional damage behind Sakura’s admiration is generalized.

findings.highlight: It’s not temporary dislike or annoyance
findings.evidenceJa: 憎いとか嫌いとか、そういう一時的な感情ではない
findings.governingReading: this is not a temporary feeling such as hatred or dislike
findings.explanation: One of the explicitly rejected emotions is weakened from hatred to annoyance.

findings.evidenceJa: 今まで綺麗なままここにいてくれた
findings.governingReading: he has remained pure or beautiful until now, with “unscarred” as the reading
findings.explanation: The crucial ruby linking Shirou’s moral purity to remaining unspoiled by wounds disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分なんかとは違う大切な存在
findings.governingReading: a precious existence unlike someone such as herself
findings.explanation: Sakura’s self-abasing contrast with Shirou is omitted.

findings.highlight: he has grown into a man
findings.governingReading: he has been rapidly becoming a man
findings.explanation: An ongoing change that newly unsettles Sakura is presented as completed.

findings.evidenceJa: 裏切りになりはしないか
findings.governingReading: might that not constitute a betrayal
findings.explanation: Sakura’s anguished self-question is promoted into a definitive moral verdict.

findings.highlight: You won’t get in any more danger if you’re hurt so badly that you can’t walk
findings.evidenceJa: 歩けなくなるぐらいの怪我をしちゃえば、もう危ない目に遭うことないですよね、先輩
findings.governingReading: if you are hurt badly enough that you cannot walk, you will not face danger anymore, will you, Senpai
findings.explanation: The intimate direct address that makes the private disabling fantasy sound like protective reassurance is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 語りかけるように呟いた
findings.explanation: The narration’s eerie simulated address to absent Shirou becomes ordinary self-talk.
